in_sanskrit.name: Raghu
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Raghu is derived from the Sanskrit root 'Raj', which means 'to rule'. It is believed that the name Raghu was given to those who ruled with passion and joy, or those who protected their people with great fervor. Raghu is also a synonym for 'Raghavan', which means 'the one who bears the Raga (emotion) of love'. The name Raghu is considered auspicious and is often used for boys.
